name: Holocloth
tagline: A real-time holographic cloth design tool
description: Drape posters and graphics on simulated fabric and watch them ripple like they're printed on holo foil — iridescent diffraction, Verlet cloth physics, macro depth of field, film grain, bump maps, and one-click transparent PNG export. Built with Three.js and React, with the physics and shaders written from scratch.

best.title: Live demo
best.note: Grab the sheet, throw it around, drape your own images over the foil.
